description: Spec #3147 ST-1: the application command surface the built-in windows receive. build.rs registers an application manifest (tauri_build::AppManifest::commands), so from now on no command reaches a window unless a capability grants it. This capability grants the app-manifest default permission set (permissions/app/default.toml) to exactly the built-in window class, so the shipped applications keep every command they had before the gate was turned on. It matches NO installed-* label: since Spec #3146 the installed tier's isolation is cardinality plus exact set - exactly one capability (installed-app-commands.json) matches installed-* and it grants exactly allow-installed-app-invoke with no core:* permission, while every other capability, this one included, still matches no installed label.
